assessments.reasoning: Chapter K of the survey instrument (Forma DANE EH 16 GEIH), titled 'OTRAS FORMAS DE TRABAJO (TRABAJO SIN REMUNERACIÓN EN PRODUCCIÓN DE SERVICIOS)', includes 6 detailed multi-part questions (questions 1 through 6) addressing unpaid domestic work and care activities (cooking, laundry, housecleaning, childcare, care for elderly/sick/disabled individuals, and homework assistance). However, this section is integrated directly into the main questionnaire document itself as Chapter K rather than being provided as a standalone module or separate questionnaire instrument outside the main questionnaire. Because it is embedded within the primary survey form rather than existing as a separate module document, the statement does not strictly hold.
